instruction: Run npm run eval:runner and complete its report.unscored.json only after inspecting every immutable artifact. Change status to scored-final only when the manual fields and validator requirements are genuinely satisfied.
omissionIds: Use only evals/benchmark-manifest.json omissionTaxonomy values; correctedOmissions must be a unique subset of baselineOmissions.
gateRule: The validator derives aggregate counts. A pass requires at least 10 completeCorrect cases, all machine numeric checks, no material fabrication, and at least 3 unique corrected omissions.
